fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) plummeted 13.4% amid sector weakness as U.S. Commerce Department delays in granting export licenses for equipment to Chinese NAND facilities raise supply concerns.
fields.summary_ko.1: Currently trading below 3x next-year net income, the company is undervalued; significant upside exists if data center and AI regulations ease, and the company maintains its #1 HBM memory position.
